reading.title: ONE CELL, TAKEN APART
lines: The diagonal cuts the cell into two right isosceles triangles. In each, the three infill pieces run from the triangle's vertices to its INCENTER — and every number the panel is built on falls out of that one rule.
incircle r = s(2−√2)/2 = 0.29289 s  ·  arm off a 45° corner = atan(√2−1) = 22.5°
1 diagonal + 2 fillers + 4 locking pieces = 7 per cell  ·  60 cells = 420 ha
